evidence.quote: These loci have the strongest evidence of genetic variation influencing the immune response to the vaccine, and include TAP2 , SNX29 , FGD2 , NAPSA , NAPSB , GM2A, C1orf85 , JUP , FBLN5 , CHST13 , DIP2A , PAM , D4S234E , C3AR1 , HERC2 , LST1 , LRRC37A4 , OAS1 , RPL14 , and DYNLT1 .
Remarkably, seven of these encode proteins involved in intracellular antigen transport and processing ( Figure 5 ).
( A ) Individuals were immunized on day 0 and peripheral blood RNA samples were obtained on days 0, 1, 3, and 14.
Genotyping was carried out on a peripheral blood genomic DNA sample obtained on day 1.
Genotyping was performed on Illumina HumanOmniExpress microarrays (Illumina, Inc., San Diego, CA) following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests were performed as previously described ( Dowdle et al., 1979 ), except for a starting serum dilution of 1:4 and the use of turkey red blood cells.
